content.short: Ora Protocol is a verifiable oracle protocol bringing AI and complex computation on-chain.
content.description: Ora Protocol is a groundbreaking infrastructure layer that enables smart contracts to interact with artificial intelligence in a trustless and verifiable manner. By utilizing Optimistic Machine Learning (opML), Ora Protocol allows for high-performance AI inferences—such as those from LLaMA or Stable Diffusion—to be executed and proven cryptographically on-chain. This eliminates the need for centralized APIs and empowers developers to build truly decentralized AI-driven applications with verifiable computations and deep integration across various blockchain networks.
